Marina S: Heads-up :eyes: — spotted a 404 on KB page `https://kb.redwood.ai/guides/kv-cache` (image 403 and a shortlink to S3 that's dead). Anyone from docs team able to triage?

Samir: On it. Can you paste the exact broken path (anchor or image link)?

Marina S: It's the inline image: `![diagram](https://short.redwood/s/kv-cache-diagram)` and the shortlink redirects to `s3://redwood-assets/kv-cache/diag.png` (403). Also anchor `#prefill-kv` resolves to 404 on staging.

DocsBot: automated-scan: Detected broken asset and dead shortlink on guides/kv-cache — filing DOCS-41234.

Casey: I can take this. Plan: rehost image to CDN, replace shortlink, add a tiny note about anchor fallback. Targeting EOD today. :thumbsup: 

Nishant: Thanks Casey — can you also add one line about TTL semantics for the kv cache? Customers keep asking about stale prefixes.

Casey: Yep. I'll update frontmatter `last_reviewed`, add TTL note, and open a tiny PR. Will tag reviewers @MarinaS and @Samir. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345

Marina S: Awesome, thanks — ping here when preview is up so we can run a quick smoke.

Casey: Deploy preview up: https://deploy-preview-12345--kb.redwood.ai/guides/kv-cache — PTAL.
